game.title: Pré-Lune
title.tagline: A hamlet grows under your fingers.
end.title: The mist has fallen
undo.label: Undo
pause.title: Paused
resume.title: Game in progress
tuto.draw: Drag your finger from the blue cottage to the lantern workshop.
tuto.erase: Tap a path to erase it.
tuto.mist: When a queue overflows, the mist rises. Hurry!
gift.title: Day {n} done!
gift.sub: The hamlet offers you a gift. Pick one.
gift.full: The bar is full. Tap the gift you want to throw away.
gift.sack.name: Tile sack
gift.roundabout.name: Roundabout
gift.roundabout.desc: Place it on a crossing: 2 creatures pass at the same time.
gift.bridge.name: Bridge
gift.bridge.desc: Goes over a path without crossing it. 2 uses.
gift.hint.roundabout: Tap a crossing to place the roundabout. Tap the gift again to put it away.
gift.hint.bridge: Drag from one path to another, over a path. Tap the gift again to put it away.
gift.err.no_junction: You need a crossing of 3 or more paths.
gift.err.already: This crossing already has a roundabout.
gift.err.ends: The bridge must start on a path and end on another path.
gift.err.doors: A building can only have 3 paths.
gift.err.blocked: A building is in the bridge's way.
gift.err.cross: The bridge must go over a path.
gift.err.tiles: Not enough tiles for this bridge.
gift.lantern.name: Lantern light
gift.lantern.desc: On a crossing: the two axes take turns.
gift.gold.name: Golden path
gift.hint.lantern: Tap a crossing to place the light. Tap the gift again to put it away.
gift.hint.gold: Tap a path, or drag along a path, to gild it (8 cells at most).
gift.err.far: These two points are not linked by a path.
